Committee: Boards, Agencies and Commissions
Sponsor: Simpson
Analyst: Robin Rawls
Date: 02/17/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 52 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Board of Examiners of Nursing Home Administrators until October 1, 2025 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Howard Sanderford, Chair
Boards, Agencies and Commissions

Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
Sponsor: Simpson
Analyst: Robin Rawls
Date: 02/25/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 52 as passed the House of Representatives provides for the continuance of the Board of Examiners of Nursing Home Administrators until October 1, 2025 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development

Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Security
Sponsor: Pringle
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 03/01/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 125 as introduced mandates completion of a motorcycle riders course for operation of a motorcycle on public roads. This bill could increase the receipts of any public entity that provides such a course, approved by the Alabama State Law Enforcement Agency, including the Alabama Traffic Safety Center at the University of Montevallo by an undetermined amount dependent upon any fees assessed by the entity.
Allen Treadaway, Chair
Public Safety and Homeland Security
